title: Apache Log4j2 JNDI features used in configuration do not protect against attacker-controlled LDAP endpoints
summary: Affected versions 2.0-beta9 through 2.14.1 allow remote code execution via crafted log messages. Upgrade to 2.15.0 or later and rotate any credentials that may have been exposed.
